g.text: Fixed depth 5 · no test-year tuning · 200-tree maximum
The selection score weights national weekly WAPE and mean regional weekly WAPE equally. Lower is better.
NASA FIRMS-derived local archive; 0.25° grid. VIIRS is an observation reference, not ground-truth fire.
